title.ko: will be -ing · will have + p.p. · be about to · be due to
title.en: will be -ing · will have + past participle · be about to · be due to

explain.ko: 미래를 나타내는 방법은 will만이 아닙니다. will be + -ing는 미래의 어느 시점에 진행 중일 일을 나타냅니다(This time tomorrow I will be flying). will have + 과거분사는 미래의 어느 시점까지 완료될 일을 나타내며 by, by then과 자주 씁니다(By next month I will have finished). be due to / be to + 동사원형은 일정이나 공식 계획을, be about to는 곧 일어날 일을 나타냅니다. 이미 정해진 일은 현재진행형(We are moving next week), 시간표는 현재형(The train leaves at six)으로 말합니다.
explain.en: There are many ways to talk about the future besides will. Will be + -ing shows an action in progress at a future time (This time tomorrow I will be flying). Will have + past participle shows completion by a future time and goes with by or by then (By next month I will have finished). Be due to / be to + verb show a schedule or official plan, and be about to shows something is imminent. Fixed arrangements use the present continuous (We are moving next week) and timetables the present simple (The train leaves at six).

notes.en: In time and condition clauses use the present: When I arrive, I'll call you.

notes.ko: will have + p.p.는 보통 by나 by then과 함께 씁니다.
notes.en: Will have + p.p. usually goes with by or by then.

notes.ko: be about to는 time 표현과 함께 쓰지 않습니다.
notes.en: Do not use be about to with a time expression.

prompt.ko: 미래의 계획과 예측을 4문장으로 써 보세요. will be -ing와 will have + p.p.를 하나씩 쓰세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences about future plans and predictions. Use will be -ing and will have + past participle once each.

task.model: This time tomorrow I will be flying to Paris. By next month this project will have finished. The meeting is due to start at three. In the long run this plan will pay off for the company.

model_trans.ko: 내일 이 시간에 저는 파리행 비행기를 타고 있을 거예요. 다음 달이면 이 프로젝트는 끝나 있을 거예요. 회의는 3시에 시작할 예정이에요. 장기적으로는 이 계획이 회사에 이익이 될 거예요.
model_trans.en: This time tomorrow I will be flying to Paris. By next month this project will have finished. The meeting is due to start at three. In the long run this plan will pay off for the company.
